messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: ur10e-manual, p. 238

When a stop is initiated by the Force Limit SF, the robot will stop. The UR Will not allow standard controller will cause motion to “back-off” to the position before the motion to force limit was exceeded. The safety controller has a fixed time (part limit settings. of the response time) allowed before a robot stop is initiated. wrist clamping Force Limits may be exceeded by the three wrist joints if the "wrist clamping torque" safety function is disabled. torque SF8 Description What happens? The Momentum Limit affects the entire 3 kg m/s Robot Will not allow motion to exceed any robot. limit settings. SF9 Description What happens? Tolerance Affects Power This function monitors the mechanical work (sum of joint torques times Limit Dynamic limiting joint angular speeds) performed by the robot, which also affects the of the 10 W Robot current to the robot arm as well as the robot speed. This safety function current/torque dynamically limits the current/torque but maintains the speed. UR10e 241 User Manual
